subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally shorten home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and changing it affects UX, privacy, docs, and possible config surface.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for home-contained paths while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable rewrites.

options.title: Switch Default To Full Paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full absolute paths everywhere and update prompts, docs, and regression tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep the compact default but add a documented opt-in for users who need full absolute paths in responses and tool displays.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for home-contained paths while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated work on the shared utility and tool-display surfaces where this product contract would be decided.
